---
title: "loo table"
format: docx
---
```{r}
exp1_loo <- readRDS("loo-df-exp1.RDS")
exp2_loo <- readRDS("loo-df-exp2.RDS")
exp3_loo <- readRDS("loo-df-exp3.RDS")

loo_df <- rbind(exp1_loo, exp2_loo, exp3_loo)

weights <- readRDS("weights_df.RDS")
weights_diff <- readRDS("weights_diff.RDS")
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(weights, caption = "Weights")
knitr::kable(weights_diff)
knitr::kable(loo_df, caption = "LOO comparissons")
knitr::kable(exp1_loo, caption = "Experiment 1: Numerosity")
knitr::kable(exp2_loo, caption = "Experiment 2: Orientation (high contrast)")
knitr::kable(exp3_loo, caption = "Experiment 3: Orientation (low contrast)")
```
